english.note: Use this only for the emphatic sense meaning that the person or group did something personally, not for an object reflexive.
Use this when the emphasis is that he personally carried out the action rather than someone else.
Use this for emphatic myself when the emphasis is on personally carrying out or witnessing the action.
Use this with 我哋 as the subject when stressing that the group personally carried out the action rather than someone else.

examples.english: The board members themselves came down to help.
examples.jyutping: baan1 dung2 si6 can1 zi6 lok6 coeng4 bong1 sau2

examples.english: The boss handled this complaint himself.
examples.traditional: 老闆親自處理呢單投訴。
examples.jyutping: lou5 baan2 can1 zi6 cyu2 lei5 ni1 daan1 tau4 sou3

examples.english: I went to the counter myself to pick up the order.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 can1 zi6 heoi3 gwai6 wai2 ling1 fo3

examples.english: We will handle the event ourselves this time.
examples.traditional: 今次個活動我哋親自搞掂。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 wut6 dung6 ngo5 dei6 can1 zi6 gaau2 dim6
